rule: Primitives transform a decision/evidence state into composition intent. They are not HTML components or Family templates.

primitives.name: Decision-first opening
mutations: hero exposes the unresolved decision rather than generic brand mood

primitives.name: Evidence-boundary adjacency
mutations: place proof/boundary beside the decision it supports

primitives.name: Route before card grid
mutations: show one legible route/state before breadth

primitives.name: Atmosphere with decision role
mutations: media/crop/whitespace carry a concrete desired state

primitives.name: Authority to proof to commitment
mutations: stage authority, then proof, then rational next event
conflicts: luxury hero followed by generic template sections

primitives.name: Local specificity before warmth
mutations: surface place/continuity evidence before generic warmth
conflicts: 地域密着 mood without proof

primitives.name: State-specific CTA
preconditions: conversion goal and customer state known
mutations: CTA names the next useful event for current state
conflicts: universal sticky CTA as only route

primitives.name: Responsive priority transform
mutations: mobile reorders or isolates the highest-priority decision unit

primitives.name: Japanese optical line composition
mutations: preserve semantic chunks and avoid isolated particles/noun fragments/one-character tails
